headline: Earnings soften year-over-year as balance sheet strengthens
summary_short: Baker Hughes reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $6,742M, down 2.4% y/y but up 2.4% q/q; net income of $681M fell 2.8% y/y and 26.8% q/q, while total cash rose to $15,727M from $3,087M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $6,742M, down 2.4% y/y and up 2.4% q/q. Gross margin was roughly flat y/y at 23.4% (22.8% q/q). Operating margin held near 12.8%, level with a year ago. Diluted EPS of $0.68 fell 4.2% y/y and 26.9% q/q; net income of $681M was down 2.8% y/y and 26.8% q/q. Total cash rose sharply to $15,727M from $3,087M y/y and $14,764M q/q. Shareholders' equity grew 12.5% y/y to $19,908M.
